requirement: The ROS-based system shall run within the documented Docker environment and provide launch modes for the Udacity Capstone Project Simulator and for site-mode playback of recorded vehicle data.
During simulator operation, the system shall follow the provided waypoint path and keep vehicle speed at or below the target top speed specified by the waypoints.

During site-mode playback of recorded vehicle data, the system shall detect and classify traffic lights in the recorded real-world images. When a red or yellow light requires stopping, it shall produce the corresponding stop-related waypoint output.
